a1.text: Welcome to Catchami — a living animal economy!

a2.text: It all starts in the real world.

a3.text: Spot a real cat or dog, throw your CamiCube...

a4.text: and it becomes a playable NFT pet, with its very own coin wallet.

b1.text: Now your pet needs to earn.

b2.text: It catches fish, and fills its bag.

b3.text: Then it sells them to a travelling merchant, who pays from its own budget.

b4.text: But working makes it hungry. So it needs food.

b5.text: Every meal costs coins, and uses fish from HQ's kitchen.

b6.text: And food changes market demand. The more fish gets eaten, the more merchants pay for it.

c2.text: HQ collects what pets spend, and sets each day's merchant budget from its reserves and recent revenue.

c3.text: Pets sell to merchants. Merchants deliver to HQ. Pets spend back into HQ. And HQ funds the next round.

d1.text: Your pet can do even more. Splash rivals in Bubble Roulette, heal up, craft gear, and trade.

e1.text: And here's the best part. Your pet doesn't need you to control every move.

e2.text: Choose a strategy, and it can work, trade, rest, and manage its own little life.

f1.text: Every pet is a real NFT. Its coins live in its own vault balance, and gameplay is settled on NEAR in batches.

g1.text: Catchami. Catch a pet. Give it a life.
